name: hookpost
description: Hookpost by Hookstep: draft and schedule social media posts on the channels you connected in Hookpost, from Cursor. Lists your channels, checks each network's rules, and saves drafts or scheduled posts to your Hookpost calendar.

HOOKPOST_API_KEY.title: Hookpost API key
HOOKPOST_API_KEY.description: Your Hookpost workspace API key, from Settings > Developers in Hookpost (Standard or Pro plan; new workspaces get 3 free posts first, no card needed).
